text:
Alex: Anyone up for doing something offbeat this weekend? thinking of a sunrise gravel ride or alternatively a bread-run + foam rolling combo :grimacing:
Mei: sunrise ride for me if we're leaving early. I can do 30mi max, pace chill 🚴‍♀️
Priya: farmers market + bread run sounds heavenly. Can swing by after — what time are you aiming for?
Connor: foam rolling team captain reporting in. will bring a thermos of suspiciously good coffee :coffee:
Jamal: I'm running a beginner skate session Saturday afternoon at the south plaza, totally free if anyone wants to try boarding for the first time. helmets provided
Alex: cool — thinking meet at the pier lot at 6:45am? that gives us time to warm up before dirt sections. @Mei you good with 6:45 or prefer 7?
Mei: 6:45 works for me. ETA route: pier -> north spit -> old mill loop. quick gravel, minimal car exposure.
Priya: I can do market after, ping me when you're back around 10am and i'll bring extra sourdough if available
Connor: foam rolling can be done in the park near the east entrance. i'll toss a yoga mat in my trunk.
Alex: perfect. also to be clear: bring lights even if early — last time was foggy.
ops-bot: FYI bike parking near pier might be limited this weekend due to event setup. consider locking + using racks on the east side.
Jamal: if anyone is curious about skate session, it's 2pm saturday, bring sneakers, knees optional. low-key, no pressure.
Mei: bringing a small first-aid kit too.
Priya: if i get good bread i'll bribe the group with pastry samples :croissant:
Connor: pastry bribe accepted. i'll bring extra coffee.
Alex: awesome — final check: meetup 6:45am pier lot, helmets/lights/lock, post-ride market for those who want. see y'all! :sunrise_over_mountains:
